Scoring Methodology

1

Raw Data Input

Upload a CSV with one row per polygon. The Polygon ID field joins each row to embedded polygon geometries for mapping. Unmapped metrics are excluded from scoring.

2

Metric Scoring (1–10)

Numeric metrics: scored with a piecewise-linear curve defined by 5 editable breakpoints.

Categorical metrics: you assign a 1–10 score to each category value found in your data.

3

Missing Data

A missing or unmapped value is excluded — both the numerator and denominator shrink so the polygon is scored on whatever data it has.

4

Weights

Weights are a 100-point budget distributed across metrics. Presets set sensible defaults — fine-tune any metric with its slider.

5

Score Interpretation

Polygons are scored 0–100. Top tier ≥ 67 (highest risk), Moderate 34–66, Low < 34.

6

Export

Results export to CSV, including the per-metric raw values, scores, weights, and contribution to the final score.

Final Score Formula

Priority Score = [ Σ ( weighti × (scorei − 1) ) ] ÷ [ Σ ( weighti × 9 ) ] × 100
